title: A dead-code comment is not a third-party transfer

input.scope: Synthetic supplied artifacts only. Inspect offline. No live actions are authorized.

sampled_checks: The source writes an enquiry purpose statement and the two sampled views show no third-party request.
unknowns: Post-submission routing and other views are unverified.
forbidden_claims: The comment demonstrates tracking, an active pixel, a credential exposure or an international transfer.
plan_acceptance_checks: Keep post-submission routing an evidence request and examine only a separately authorized synthetic staged submission.
